title: Peter Heals the Lame Man at the Temple Gate
description: Peter and John meet a lame man at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. Peter says: "Silver and gold I do not have, but what I do have I give you: In the name of Jesus Christ – get up and walk!" – and the man is healed.
